content.title: Virtual Court Decorum Order
content.summary: The Arvada Municipal Court has established a Virtual Court Decorum Order effective April 3, 2025, allowing virtual hearings for cases upon prior request and approval. Participants must ensure audio and video capabilities, adhere to decorum rules such as appropriate dress and behavior, and avoid recording the hearing. Violations of these rules may result in removal from the hearing and rescheduling for an in-person appearance.
content.body:
[Request for Virtual Hearing](https://arvada.form.transform.civicplus.com/64145)

[Virtual Court Decorum Agreement](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/54722) - To be filled out and submitted once a Request for Virtual Hearing has been submitted and approved by the Judge.

## Presiding Judge Order - Virtual Court Decorum  Effective April 3, 2025

Your request for a virtual hearing on the above listed case in the Arvada Municipal Court has been granted. The Municipal Court has issued the following Orders with respect to Virtual Hearings.

1. Virtual Hearings will be limited to those parties who make a request in advance and have sufficient reason for the request. The Court will review all requests for Virtual Hearings on a case by case basis and will make a determination if the request is approved. If the request is not approved, the case will be set for an in person hearing.
2. All parties seeking a request for a Virtual Hearing must agree in advance that all parties associated with the hearing will have both audio and video capabilities and that both audio and video will be turned on at all times during the Virtual Hearing.
3. The Court will not approve a Virtual Hearing for any hearings requiring testimony or introduction of evidence including but not limited to Motions Hearings, Restitution Hearings, Revocation Hearings, Court Trials or Jury Trials.
4. If a Virtual Hearing is granted, the Court Orders that the following rules of decorum be followed:
   1. Arrive on time and follow virtual platform instructions.
   2. Do not record the hearing by any means.
   3. Identify yourself in the virtual meeting with your real name.
   4. Dress appropriately for Court.
   5. Eliminate distractions. Please locate a quiet area and minimize interruptions by others.
   6. All parties should be in a location appropriate for a Virtual Hearing. If there is excessive background noise, poor connectivity, or if it appears that a party is actively driving or engaging in other distracting or dangerous activity, the Court will reschedule the hearing and/or find that the party has failed to appear. Any resulting delay will be attributed to the party.
   7. Do not speak out of turn.
   8. Please mute your audio setting until it is your turn to speak.
   9. Be courteous and respectful to all Virtual Court participants. Use good manners; ensure that your physical and facial expressions are appropriate and uphold the dignity of a court setting - no profanity.
   10. Inappropriate, disruptive or disrespectful behavior will not be tolerated. Individuals who engage in such conduct will be removed from the hearing and/or will be held in Contempt of Court.
   11. Do not eat food during the Virtual Hearing - this includes chewing gum.
   12. Do not smoke, use tobacco, or vaping products in the Virtual Courtroom.
   13. Sit up straight and do not prop your feet up on a table or chair.
5. If the rules of decorum are not followed, the Judge will Order that you be removed from the Virtual Hearing and your case will be reset for an in person hearing.

The Court finds that these Orders are appropriate and necessary to the efficient and effective administration of justice in the City of Arvada.

**Dated and effective this 3rd Day of April 2025**

**By the Court:**

**Kathryn Kurtz  
Presiding Judge  
City of Arvada Municipal Court**
